verdict.rationale: Galileo ships an official Python SDK: there is a first-party GitHub repo (rungalileo/galileo-python) with a `@log` decorator for spans, cookbooks state they are built on "Galileo's Python SDK", and docs under an sdk-api section cover OTel distributed tracing with a GalileoSpanProcessor. The evidence shows only one language and shallow SDK reference detail. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in languages beyond Python (e.g. TypeScript/JS), in-depth SDK API reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
